# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== expr bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    x = o.{k}
End Sub
=== target bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    o.{k} = 1
End Sub
=== call bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    o.{k} 1
End Sub
=== bang bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    x = o!{k}
End Sub
=== chain bas
Sub Probe(o As Object)
    x = o.a.{k}.b
End Sub
